title: Runtime pane
responsibility: Shows one recorded screenshot or the reason its capture is unavailable.

inputs.name: RuntimePane.item
inputs.description: Evidence item with file, phase, missing flag/note and display facts. Missing items are not fetched. Before phase reads before; other phases read after.

inputs.name: RuntimePane.title
inputs.description: Required figure heading and accessible name.

inputs.name: RuntimePane.role
inputs.description: Required descriptive badge such as Parent commit or Branch tip.

inputs.name: RuntimePane.evidence
inputs.description: URL-reading state. Failed promises become displayed problems; callbacks from superseded requests are ignored.

outputs.name: RuntimePane
outputs.description: Figure with screenshot after URL resolution, plus standing/status. Missing capture, failed verification and loading have separate messages. Non-Fresh capture standings receive stale styling.
